subject: Discovery recap & next steps — stakeholder owners, legal routing, and redline cadence
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sam O'Neill <sam.oneill@healthlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — stakeholder owners, legal routing, and redline cadence

Hi Sam / Elena — thanks again for a productive 45-min call today. Quick recap + asks so we can move the pilot and contracting cadence forward.

High-level buyer priorities (as heard on the call):
- Primary decision criteria: predictable latency (p50 <150ms for short queries), strong privacy controls (VPC + KMS), and predictable unit economics for pilot/production.
- Security bar: SOC 2 Type II and DPA required; vulnerability scanning and pen-test report requested.
- Timeline: pilot kickoff target = first week of July; procurement aim = mid-July for MSA signature.

Stakeholder map (please confirm owners):
- Economic buyer: Sam O'Neill (CFO) — financial sign-off and commercial terms
- Product / Technical sponsor: Dr. Elena Ruiz (Head of Data Science) — owns pilot success criteria
- Security & Privacy: (need confirmed name) — DPA and evidence requirements
- Procurement / Legal intake: Raj Patel — contract handling and PO process

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the primary legal contact who will receive our MSA/DPA redlines? If possible share direct email for intake.
2) We attached the meeting notes and our standard NDA for convenience — please sign the NDA (or confirm you already have a signed copy) so we can exchange the pen-test checklist and SOC artifacts.
3) Ben will own procurement dialogue and mapping of your contract flow; Priyom will own redline shepherding on our side.

Outline of suggested legal sequencing (we recommend):
- NDA (if not in place) -> DPA (data processing terms) -> MSA (commercial + liability)
- Typical turn time per round: 3–7 business days for standard customers; we can compress to 2–3 days if we escalate on both sides for the pilot.

Attachments: [Attachment: Healthlytics_meeting_notes_20280614.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

I’ll leave the thread open for you to confirm legal/who signs and any changes to timelines. Once legal is confirmed I’ll schedule a 30-min alignment with your legal/procurement and our contracts lead to surface any non-standard terms upfront.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin

Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps — stakeholder owners, legal routing, and redline cadence

Marcus — great notes, thanks. Quick confirmations from our side:

- Economic buyer: yes, I will be the commercial sign-off (CFO).
- Product sponsor: Elena will run the pilot (success metrics: latency percentiles, prompt-cost per session, model hallucination checks).
- Security & Privacy: Priya Menon (pri.legal@healthlytics.com) is our primary legal/privacy contact — she owns DPA and SOC evidence intake. I’ve cc'd her in another thread but copying here for visibility.
- Procurement: Raj will handle PO and purchase order flow; his timeline is typically constrained by quarter close but he can move quickly for pilots.

We have a signed NDA attached from our side — attaching here. Our legal team prefers to review the DPA first before deep MSA redlines, but we can do NDA -> DPA -> MSA as you propose. Typical legal turn times: 3 business days to review DPA, 3–5 days for MSA redline rounds. We can compress those to 2–3 days if we mutually prioritize the pilot.

Attachments: [Attachment: NDA_Healthlytics_signed.pdf (PDF, 82KB)]

Next steps from Healthlytics:
- Priya will accept NDAs and queue DPA intake (Priya: can your team share any DPA template requirements or must-include clauses?)
- Raj will share procurement intake form (Raj: please send the PO template + any data classification form we need to complete).

Happy to hop on a short legal alignment call next week if that helps expedite.

Best — Sam

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps — stakeholder owners, legal routing, and redline cadence

Looping in our contracts playbook here and proposing a concrete runbook:

Proposed sequencing and owners (internal):
- NDA verification (Ben) — ensure Healthlytics-signed NDA is ingested into contract tracker and shared with Priya for evidence exchange.
- DPA intake (Priyom) — request required privacy clauses, encryption/KMS expectations, data retention limits; push for templated DPA where possible.
- MSA negotiation (Ben + Legal) — commercial terms, indemnity, liability caps.

Suggested redline cadence:
- Round 1: exchange redlines on DPA (target 3 business days)
- Round 2: exchange redlines on MSA (target 3–5 business days)
- If a problematic clause is flagged (e.g., cross-border processing, indemnity carve-outs), escalate to Legal Counsel for an exception decision (2 business day SLAs when escalated).

Attachments: [Attachment: redline_playbook_v3.docx (DOCX, 240KB)]

Operational asks for Marcus / Healthlytics:
1) Marcus — please share HubSpot deal id (or confirm HLT-2028-042) so I can attach all contract artifacts to the deal.
2) Marcus — schedule an intake call with Priya + our contracts lead (I can join) to align DPA must-haves and expected turn times.

I’ll draft a one-page redline guide for Priya to set expectations and speed up the first DPA pass. We should also surface any unusual procurement terms (PO timing, tax forms).

— Ben
